project.title: NASA Psyche Mission: AR/WebXR for Public Engagement—CERNN: Lore and Mythology Experience

section-description.title: Project Overview
section-description.description: The project outlines an interactive Augmented Reality (AR) experience designed to educate the general public about NASA’s Psyche mission by blending real-world astronomical discovery with its namesake Greek mythology.

item.detail: Likened to a chrysalis in Greek myth, the asteroid represents a planetary "soul" whose failure to become a full planet mirrors the goddess Psyche falling into a deep sleep.
The spacecraft's butterfly-like solar panels symbolize the "breath of life," framing its scientific mission as a way to grant the asteroid immortality.
Users play as an 1852 astronomer using an interactive AR telescope to discover the asteroid before viewing rotatable 3D videos that explain its mythological connections.
Users watch the 2023 spacecraft launch and travel through space while an animated winged overlay connects the modern scientific journey to the goddess's myth.
The primary challenge is designing and building the complex 3D AR models required for the historical telescope, the mythological figures, and the rocket launch.
The highly inclusive app will feature intuitive gesture controls, written text, full audio descriptions, and a dedicated audio-only mode for visually impaired users.

section-description.title: Core Functional Requirements
section-description.description: Refined Sponsor requirements to the creation of a two-phase, gamified mythological experience about the Psyche asteroid and spacecraft that integrates interactive discovery mechanics, lore-driven vector graphics, and comprehensive UI/UX designs.

item.detail: The Asteroid Mythos Phase gamifies the historical discovery by having users search for the asteroid within a timed Skybox using a virtual telescope.
A lore section follows that uses glowing, constellation-style vector images to connect the asteroid's nature to a chrysalis and the sleeping goddess Psyche.
The Spacecraft Mythos Phase covers the modern mission by displaying the spacecraft's launch and an arrival timer.
Butterfly vector graphics to symbolize the "Breath of Life" and framing the scientific documentation as a way for the goddess to achieve immortality.
Designed and delivered comprehensive UI mockups for the launch interface, settings menu, interactive dialog boxes, and help screens to establish the visual language and user flow.

section-description.title: System Architecture & Frontend Implementation
section-description.description: Architected system flows and engineered the foundational frontend elements for the second phase of the gamified lore experience, translating comprehensive UI/UX mockups into interactive user features.

item.detail: Architected a detailed, low-level user experience flow derived from high-level requirements to accurately map the narrative progression of the asteroid lore.
Developed comprehensive UML Activity Diagrams to visualize the application architecture and strictly guide the frontend engineering lifecycle.
Designed high-fidelity mockups for the core application screens, including the main dashboard and launch page, establishing the visual aesthetic of the Psyche lore experience.
Created standardized interface assets, including thematic papyrus scroll graphics, help screens, and settings menus, utilizing component-driven design patterns to maximize asset reusability.
Implemented responsive frontend views for the primary experience pages, seamlessly translating conceptual UI designs into functional web components.
Engineered the foundational logic and interactive scope for the core "finding feature" mechanic on the main page to actively drive user discovery and engagement.

section-description.title: Implementation & Asset Development
section-description.description: Executed the development of the Asteroid Mythos Phase (AMP) by engineering an interactive mobile-compatible telescope search mechanic, designing realistic 3D and 2D environmental assets, and implementing responsive UI/UX control popups to seamlessly guide the user's lore experience.

item.detail: Engineered a mobile-compatible search mechanic that dynamically randomizes the asteroid's location, keeping it hidden from view until successfully aligned within the interactive telescope.
Programmed fluid star-moving animations and automated state transitions that trigger immediately upon the user's discovery of the meteorite.

Enhanced the graphical fidelity of the main page by integrating a realistic 3D asteroid model alongside a rich, multi-layered 2D environment featuring a Naples observatory, grassy terrain, and foreground telescope.

Created and integrated thematic vector graphics—including constellations, a chrysalis, a butterfly, and the sleeping goddess Psyche—to visually communicate the asteroid's historical and mythological connections.
Developed comprehensive user control features, including responsive settings interfaces and an inactivity-triggered help popup to guide navigation without breaking immersion.
Implemented a timed, responsive "papyrus scroll" UI component for introductory text and programmed smooth, interconnected transitions for the astronomer and mythological lore popups.

section-description.title: Interactive Environment & UI Execution
section-description.description: Engineered immersive 3D space environments and implemented dynamic, responsive user interfaces to facilitate engaging, self-paced interactive storytelling across all major devices and browsers.

item.detail: Developed a cohesive 3D space environment featuring a beautified starfield and a dynamically rendered asteroid belt to accurately contextualize the Psyche asteroid.
Programmed immersive visual effects, including dynamic background blurring, target-focused dimming, and smooth camera transitions to seamlessly guide user attention during satellite orientation.
Designed and implemented responsive UI layouts across multiple engagement phases (AMP-L, SMP-C, SMP-E, SMP-L), integrating animated informational modals, cinematic typing effects, and autoplay video.
Engineered self-paced exploration mechanics utilizing intuitive navigation triggers, time-delayed help popups, and standardized design assets to elevate the lore progression experience.
Resolved critical text encoding issues and universal bugs to guarantee a seamless, accessible user experience across all major hardware devices and web browsers.
Authored comprehensive backend developer documentation and finalized overarching project infrastructure updates, including global footer synchronization.

stage.title: Sprint 4: Asset Refinement, Audio Integration & Quality Assurance

section-description.title: Asset Refinement, Audio Integration & Quality Assurance
section-description.description: Engineered historically accurate 3D visual assets, integrated immersive audio systems, and executed rigorous cross-platform testing protocols to optimize the interactive narrative experience for final delivery.

item.detail: Developed and textured a historically accurate 3D telescope model, seamlessly integrating the asset into the primary search phases to strictly align with sponsor specifications.
Enhanced 3D environmental realism within the asteroid belt by introducing varied mesh sizing, detailed texturing, and dynamic depth-of-field scope blurring that accurately tracks the user's cursor.
Implemented a comprehensive audio architecture, embedding thematic background music and interactive UI sound effects across the AMP and SMP narrative phases to significantly heighten user immersion.

Calibrated overall application pacing and narrative flow by eliminating redundant phase delays, optimizing dynamic countdown timers, and resolving layout alignment issues for critical textual overlays.
Executed extensive cross-platform compatibility testing across multiple mobile devices to systematically identify, document, and triage hardware-specific rendering anomalies.
Conducted a formal Accessibility Evaluation to verify the application met stringent sponsor compliance standards, ensuring an inclusive and navigable interface for diverse user groups.

stage.title: Sprint 5: Performance Optimization, Asset Refinement & Quality Assurance

section-description.title: Performance Optimization, Asset Refinement & Quality Assurance
section-description.description: Engineered high-performance 3D assets, integrated immersive audio systems, and executed comprehensive cross-platform optimizations to finalize a historically accurate, highly responsive interactive narrative.

item.detail: Developed and integrated a historically accurate 3D telescope model, implementing dynamic cursor-tracking mechanics, depth-of-field blurring, and detailed textures to elevate the core search experience.

Optimized environmental rendering performance by reducing 3D mesh polygon counts, scaling down asteroid volume, and simplifying background particle systems to guarantee smooth execution on lower-end hardware.
Implemented a unified audio architecture, embedding thematic background music and interactive UI sound effects across all narrative phases to deepen user immersion.
Designed and engineered advanced navigation tools, including chapter progress bars, an auto-find mechanic, dynamic countdown timers, and cinematic fade transitions to streamline storytelling pacing.
Refined interactive layouts by centering phase content, adjusting overlay alignments, and ensuring global navigation controls remained accessible during dialog and narrative events.
Resolved critical OS-specific rendering anomalies, correcting typography encoding and complex layout alignment issues for Linux distributions to ensure visual parity.
Executed rigorous mobile compatibility testing and an accessibility evaluation, systematically resolving responsive scaling bugs and optimizing interface elements for varied screen dimensions.

Debugged and stabilized core application flow, eliminating console errors during timer sequences, bypassing redundant loading screens, and refining user onboarding to deliver a seamless final product.

stage.title: Sprint 6: Architecture Refactoring, Documentation & Final Polish

section-description.title: Architecture Refactoring, Documentation & Final Polish
section-description.description: Refactored core application architecture for enhanced maintainability, authored comprehensive technical documentation for sponsor handoff, and executed global UX/UI bug fixes to ensure cross-platform stability.

item.detail: Refactored monolithic JavaScript files into scalable, modular architectures to improve codebase maintainability and developer readability.

Authored extensive technical documentation, encompassing inline code comments, comprehensive README guides, and structured post-mortem reviews to facilitate seamless sponsor handoff and future development.
Enhanced interface consistency by standardizing global typography, rectifying mission timer alignments, and updating context page assets for a cohesive user journey.
Polished interactive mechanics by adjusting onboarding popup frequencies, resolving 3D asteroid blurriness, and streamlining UI interactions such as disabling the targeting scope post-discovery.
Integrated critical Linux-specific layout fixes and audio subsystems directly into the primary development branch to guarantee cross-platform environmental parity.
Resolved lingering application bugs by clearing persistent console errors, fixing missing favicon assets, and updating hyperlinking behaviors to finalize application stability.

stage.title: Sprint 7: Quality Assurance, Mobile Optimization & Public Release Finalization

section-description.title: Quality Assurance, Mobile Optimization & Public Release Finalization
section-description.description: Executed rigorous quality assurance protocols, engineered mobile-responsive interface updates, and resolved critical application logic bugs to finalize the interactive experience for public deployment.

item.detail: Executed comprehensive quality plan protocols, validating system integrity through rigorous testing of edge-case scenarios, session duration limits, interactive mechanics, and narrative accuracy.
Facilitated formal beta testing sessions to capture and synthesize end-user feedback, systematically evaluating mission relatability and overall user satisfaction.
Engineered mobile-responsive interface enhancements by dynamically scaling core interaction buttons and typography to guarantee an intuitive experience across diverse screen dimensions.
Rectified transient UI rendering glitches during context state transitions, eliminating unauthorized visual artifacts to maintain a cohesive, professional graphical presentation.
Resolved high-priority application logic faults, implementing robust event debouncing on navigation buttons to prevent program crashes and restoring disabled modal functionality.

Finalized user onboarding mechanics and global configuration settings, strategically disabling background tracking interactions during cinematic phases and calibrating help prompt timers for optimal pacing.
